sequence: Set CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER before process start and verify every hash/identity.
Start a fresh process with capture disabled, ACTIVE_FROM_START=0, and a fresh trace directory.
Run the exact model/runtime no-trace prewarm outside MEASUREMENT_ACTIVE; verify checksum and zero trace payloads.
Require normal child exit, first-kernel completion, no surviving child/GPU process, and MEASUREMENT_ACTIVE absent; only then write READY.
After READY, parent creates the budget lease and MEASUREMENT_ACTIVE, verifies no pre-arm trace, writes immutable arm identity, then permits the one capture window.
On timeout/nonzero exit, terminate the process group (SIGTERM; 2 s grace; SIGKILL only if needed), retain evidence, and do not reuse the directory.
bounded_prewarm.hard_gate: A prewarm trace, nonzero process count, missing READY, stale marker, or identity/hash mismatch blocks measurement.

raw_trace_closure.strategy: Remote SHA256 and size are recorded first; copy to a distinct local path; calculate local SHA256 and size; require equality for every payload; publish the index/receipt; keep raw payloads out of Git. Do not delete remote evidence until remote_only_required_artifact_count is zero and the closure receipt is validated.
